_doc: Forge model routing / quota tiering (user decisions 2026-07-03). Lead (main session) stays on Opus (owner-set; 'opusplan' recommended = Opus plans, Sonnet executes). Subagents default to the tier here; the Lead may ESCALATE a specific subagent to opus when it is the highest-stakes on THIS task, or DROP a truly-trivial one to haiku. Route by ALIAS (opus/sonnet/haiku/fable) via the Agent-tool `model` param (or subagent frontmatter `model:`, or CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL). Forge logs the ACTUAL model used in FORGE_AGENT_LEDGER.md + the dashboard event 'agent_model_used' (registered 2026-08-01 in forge-dashboard/log-event.cjs + forge-bin/forge-verify.cjs + forge-dashboard/app.js), shaped {event_type:'agent_model_used', agent, model, source, note}. The model field is MANDATORY and must be null when the runtime model is genuinely not observable — a placeholder or guess is STRICT-REFUSED, so this event is never a claim about a model nobody checked. Guidance only — never overrides governance, security, QA, or TOKEN_EFFICIENCY_GLOBAL_POLICY. Forge cannot auto-switch the session model; it may only recommend.
precedence: hardTasksAlwaysOpus and neverHaiku OVERRIDE every role default below. A role's 'mayEscalateTo' is discretionary ONLY for work that is NOT on those lists. If the task matches hardTasksAlwaysOpus it MUST run on opus regardless of the role default; if it matches neverHaiku it must NOT run on haiku.

lead.note: Owner keeps the main session on Opus (or 'opusplan' = Opus plans, Sonnet executes). Forge cannot auto-switch the session model; it may recommend the owner run /model opus or /model opusplan.

fable.use: Opt-in only, owner-invoked (/model fable) for long-horizon single-sitting-plus work; heaviest quota, slowest; NEVER a Forge default.

planner.note: Plan / master-prompt — the best use of Opus quota.

engineer.escalateWhen: multi-file / unfamiliar codebase / hard debug after a Sonnet attempt (discretionary)

backend-dev.escalateWhen: auth / data-model / migration work — matches hardTasksAlwaysOpus, so escalation is MANDATORY not discretionary

reviewer.escalateWhen: security- or architecture-critical diff — matches hardTasksAlwaysOpus, so escalation is MANDATORY not discretionary

qa.dropWhen: pure screenshot / proof logging with no judgement

researcher.dropWhen: simple fact lookup / single doc fetch

hardTasksAlwaysOpus: hard debug after a first Sonnet attempt

effort.note: sonnet / Opus 4.8 / Fable 5 support low|medium|high|xhigh|max (default high). Tuning effort is often a better lever than switching model. Where a Workflow runtime is available, agent() also takes opts.effort; separately, add 'ultrathink' in a prompt to raise the thinking budget for a one-off deep pass without changing session effort.

quotaHygiene: reference files by path (don't paste full content)
summarize logs to a path pointer
smallest team that fits (over-spawning is the #1 waste)
compact internal output; full only for deliverables
honesty: Log the ACTUAL model each subagent ran on. Never claim a model that wasn't used. Never fabricate quota 'savings' numbers — real savings need real measurement.
